notes: 'have I cast thee as profane' heads on 'profane' by rule 44's subtraction test; the competing head on 'cast' is named in the unit's note, as rule 8 requires.
The article of הַסֹּכֵךְ is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'O covering cherub' with neither a 'the' nor a relative — the correct contrast with v.14, where 'that' is written (rules 36, 41).
'with violence' stays with the noun as an accusative of material under rule 33, which rule 44's closing clause expressly does not touch.
